bluf: Thrive Internet Marketing Agency is an Arlington, TX full service agency founded 2005, selling SEO first (including ChatGPT SEO for AI citations), then content, local, PPC and web builds to SMBs, citing over 1,000 client reviews. It practises what it sells on all 3 tested lines: llms.txt published, 20 AI search URLs, own Google ads and 534 sitemap URLs updated in 365 days. Its latest news posts, 2026-09-21 to 2026-09-28, are all about reviews. The one thing a rival should know: all 11 clients on record are names only, no pricing model is public, and the Monsoon read puts displacement at 69.9, a book that buys on price.
doing:
The positioning line reads: full service, strategy first digital marketing agency built on relationships and results, serving thousands of businesses from startups to large franchises: in plain words, a volume SEO and web shop for small business. The headline claim is social proof: more than 1,000 client reviews, backed by wins like Qualis Roofing's 427% keyword jump.

The sold mix leads with SEO at score 3: the meta leads with SEO, seven SEO menu lines and a homepage testimonial citing roughly 800% ROI. Five lines score 2 at core: AI Search / GEO (a ChatGPT SEO service page, an AI search guide series, 20 AI search URLs); Content & Digital PR (link building, digital PR, HARO and content writing, 1,400+ news articles); Local (the Qualis Roofing visibility case across Dallas-Fort Worth, franchise SEO, PPC and social lines); Paid Search (seven PPC menu lines, a TruckAC+ rebuild credited with 23X ROAS in six months); and Web & Product (website builds for small businesses, credit unions and franchises). Eight lines score 1, AI automation 0, breadth 14; no proprietary product or partner is listed.

AI posture: it sells AI SEO and ChatGPT SEO for AI citations, runs an AI search guide series, and describes human overseen AI automation in its workflow.

Dated moves: one award, Gold and Silver Tellys for the REVO2 social video campaign, undated in the moves list but a news post dates it 2026-05-21. The news feed runs 2026-05-25 (lead quality), 2026-05-26 (online reviews) and five posts from 2026-09-21 to 2026-09-28 on reviews, review velocity and agency versus in house ROI. The jobs list holds 4 roles, organic social, SEO and paid media strategists and a marketing consultant; no ATS was found.

Pricing signals are absent. For an agency claiming thousands of businesses served, it holds no employee count, no ownership, no dated client case beyond three 2015 social posts, and no measurement line above score 1.
clients:
The client type on record is SMB, across home services, franchises, credit unions, healthcare, education, ecommerce and food manufacturing; the home market is the US from Arlington, TX.

The record names 11 clients: 0 observed and 11 names only, all from portfolio pages or the homepage, none shared with another tracked agency. No row carries a need code, so every need is inferred from what the agency leads with, SEO with web builds, local and PPC behind it. The capability notes carry two named results the client rows lack: Qualis Roofing's 427% jump in top 10 keywords and local visibility across Dallas-Fort Worth, and the TruckAC+ paid media rebuild credited with 23X ROAS in six months. The other nine are portfolio names: USI Remodeling, Restoration 1 Franchise, Houston Texas Fire Fighters Federal Credit Union, Priority Trust Credit Union, CTI Foods, Brazos Higher Education, Datadobi, Moishe's Moving Systems and Prince of Peace Ginger, a portfolio the web note says is dominated by website builds. The dated case studies on record are not client rows: a Thrive Local index at 2024-11-18 and three 2015 social posts for unnamed law firms (retweet reach up 1686%, Facebook engagement up 385%).

The observed mix is empty. What this base needs next: small businesses and franchises buying SEO hours sit under KJ6 (The agency middle is being hollowed out) and KJ1 (The click is being replaced by the citation), where the record places Thrive best on its AI search line; it is likely, with moderate confidence, that these clients ask next for a citation number, and the record shows no audited product to give them one. The reputation content run of September 2026 suggests, with low confidence, that review management is the next line it sells them.
house: Say and do: 3 of 3 tested lines are practised on its own house. AI Search / GEO is corroborated: it publishes an llms.txt and 20 AI topic URLs sit in its sitemap. Paid Search is corroborated: the Transparency Center lookup on its domain shows 19 ads, 6 in the last 30 days, last shown 2026-09-27, though the advertiser names the record lists are Rize Ideas, LLC and an individual account rather than the agency's own name. Publishing cadence is corroborated on the year: the sitemap lists 2083 URLs, 534 updated in 365 days but only 1 in 90, against a news feed carrying five posts dated 2026-09-21 to 2026-09-28. LinkedIn advertising shows 1 company page ad. The pixel stack is wide: LinkedIn Insight, TikTok, X and Reddit pixels with GTM and Google Ads on WordPress; no test tool or ABM stack was detected. No AI crawlers are blocked. No Meta or TikTok ad library reading is on record.
market:
Horus reads Thrive at a tailwind index of 5.1, band Neutral, 29th percentile. It is best placed for KJ1, the click being replaced by the citation, driven by AI Search / GEO at +2 and Content & Digital PR at +1 against SEO at -1. It is most exposed to KJ6, the agency middle being hollowed out, at net -0.225 with SEO, Paid Search and Content & Digital PR each at -1. Best scenario fit is The Walled Oasis at 38/100. It is partial on P1, P3 (local at depth, no LSA or Sponsored Places work), P4 and P7; absent on P2, P6 and P8; P5 unknown.

Monsoon reads 63.9, band Onshore wind, 82nd percentile: migration 57.9 against displacement 69.9, a book that buys on price. The verdict puts 58 of the index on the sold mix, SEO and Web & Product carrying the most movable hours; the shore split is 65% South and Southeast Asia and 25% Latin America. No hub office and no onshore claim is listed; the footprint is inferred.
openings:
The strongest opening is price. The Monsoon read puts displacement at 69.9 on an SMB book: a rival delivering SEO and web builds from South and Southeast Asia or Latin America is likely, with moderate confidence, to undercut it line by line, and an outcome priced offer sharpens it, since no pricing model is on record (P5 unknown). The falsifier: evidence on record that the book does not buy on price, such as a published premium rate.

The gap to lead with is the audited number. Thrive is best placed for KJ1 on AI SEO, yet no tracking, scorecard or citation share product shows (P1 partial), no feed, schema or entity line exists on a core SEO and web mix (P2 absent), and no LSA or Sponsored Places work backs a local line it sells at depth (P3 partial). A rival leading with a citation share number, an entity service and LSA management takes three lines.

Contestable clients: all 11 clients on record are names only, so the nine portfolio names, from USI Remodeling to Prince of Peace Ginger, are clients whose current agency is unconfirmed; the two named results, Qualis Roofing and TruckAC+, are the ones to test.
watch: I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures, next reading October 2026: output or outcome pricing announced at a top five holdco would raise the cost of its missing pricing model under KJ6, the judgment it is most exposed to.

I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, next reading late October 2026: search and other growth below 10% flags cannibalization of the SEO hours it leads with; above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1 and the KJ1 tailwind on its AI SEO line.
I10, Reddit US daily users against search referral volatility, next reading late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk under KJ1.

I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend, rolling: pricing below $20 CPM would signal supply outrunning demand and change the KJ2 read on its paid search line, where it shows no assistant ads test (P8 absent).
Follow up the September 2026 run of reputation posts (2026-09-21 to 2026-09-28) for a review management service line, and the four open strategist roles for hiring pace.
